---
name: gbk-source-encoding
description: Game source files under projects/NarutoSenki/Classes/ are GBK-encoded — edit with byte-safe tools, not the Edit tool
metadata:
  type: project
---

Several files under `projects/NarutoSenki/Classes/` (e.g. `Element.cpp`, `ActionManager.cpp`, `Characters.cpp`, `Effect.cpp`) are **GBK-encoded** (verified: invalid UTF-8, decodes cleanly as GBK, contains Chinese text). Framework code under `cocos2dx/` is mostly plain ASCII and safe to edit normally.

**Why:** The Read/Edit tools assume UTF-8. Reading a GBK file mojibakes the Chinese bytes, so an Edit `old_string` won't match reliably — and a write can corrupt the Chinese text, breaking in-game strings and the anti-tamper MD5 check.

**How to apply:** For any file under `Classes/` that contains non-ASCII bytes, edit with a byte-safe tool (e.g. `perl -i` byte substitution) instead of the Edit tool. After editing, verify no encoding damage: `git diff | grep -cP '^[+-].*[\x80-\xFF]'` should be `0` (a non-zero count means you touched multibyte lines). Check a file first with `iconv -f UTF-8 -t UTF-8 <file>` — if it errors, treat the file as GBK. Related: [[project-goals-and-open-bugs]].

===build_native.sh contents===
#!/bin/bash
# NarutoSenki 安卓 native 构建脚本(cocos2d-x 2.2.6)
# 经验证可用于 Apple Silicon Mac:
#   - 老 NDK r10e 不认 arm64 宿主 → 用 arch -x86_64 经 Rosetta 跑,uname 返回 x86_64
#   - import-module 需要 NDK_MODULE_PATH 指向框架根 + android 预编译库目录
set -e

DIR="$( cd "$( dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}" )" && pwd )"
ROOT="$( cd "$DIR/../../.." && pwd )"          # 框架根(含 cocos2dx/external/extensions…)

: "${NDK_ROOT:=$HOME/Library/Android/android-ndk-r10e}"
export NDK_ROOT
export NDK_MODULE_PATH="$ROOT:$ROOT/cocos2dx/platform/third_party/android/prebuilt"

echo "NDK_ROOT        = $NDK_ROOT"
echo "NDK_MODULE_PATH = $NDK_MODULE_PATH"
echo "构建目录        = $DIR"

# 经 Rosetta 调 ndk-build(arm64 宿主必需)
arch -x86_64 /bin/bash -c "\
  export NDK_ROOT='$NDK_ROOT'; \
  export NDK_MODULE_PATH='$NDK_MODULE_PATH'; \
  '$NDK_ROOT/ndk-build' -C '$DIR' \
     APP_ABI=armeabi-v7a NDK_DEBUG=0 -j4 \"\$@\"" -- "$@"

echo "✅ native 构建完成,产物在 $DIR/libs/"

**Ultimate goal:** add **LAN multiplayer (无服务器局域网对战)** — no server, local network only.

**Done so far:** Win32 modernized to VS2026 (v145); Mac migration + native prebuilt libs restored; Android port via **NDK r10e + armeabi-v7a 32-bit** (方案 A) building a playable APK (package `dev.leaderone.narutosenki`, lib `libcocos2dcpp.so`); Pain/Orochimaru characters revived; Pain→Nagato ultimate-2 transformation branch.

**Android rebuild loop:** `./build_native.sh && ./gradlew assembleDebug && adb install -r <apk>`. See [[android-crash-debug-workflow]] for the crash-capture method and the debug-signing gotcha. Test device: OnePlus 13 (PJZ110, Android 15, arm64 running the 32-bit build).

**CRASHES FIXED (2026-07-23, commits 87b8cf1 + 0285a47):** The "random / ultimate / settlement" crashes shared ONE root cause — an **anti-piracy trap** in `GameLayer::checkTower()` (GameLayer.cpp:936/941). It checked the app was the original `net.zakume.game` package (decoded from `"rix2~eoyqi2keqi"`, a −4 Caesar shift) and, on failure (repackaged app), set `_CharacterArray=NULL`. `checkTower()` runs from `Tower::dealloc()`, so the **first tower to fall nulled the roster array**, and every later access (setClone ultimate/clone/summon, initGard guardian, settlement iteration) crashed. Stealthy delayed/remote failure = why prior agents kept patching crash sites without finding it. Fix: neutered 936/941, guarded initGard:344, and disabled the checkMD5 kill-gates in SelectLayer/NetworkLayer. Also fixed `nativeOnPause` null-deref (lock-screen crash) in the framework renderer. **Verified: a full match (towers fell + settlement shown) ran with zero crashes, no new tombstones.** All other anti-tamper checks (checkMD5 in Element/GameLayer, IMEI/MAC) were already neutered by prior agents.

1. **AI characters don't attack** (e.g. Sai/rat/tiger stay passive) — audit `doAI`. NOT yet addressed.
2. Nagato skill-icon/portrait missing from `UI.png` atlas (cosmetic). Ultimate-1 cooldown not applying (balance).

**方案 B (not started):** 64-bit `arm64-v8a` for store release — modern NDK (r25+), STL migration `gnustl_static → c++_static`, recompile third-party libs 64-bit, partial framework source upgrade.

---
name: android-crash-debug-workflow
description: How to reliably capture & symbolicate NarutoSenki native crashes on the OnePlus 13, plus the debug-signing install gotcha
metadata:
  type: reference
---

Reliable Android native-crash debugging for this repo (solves the "崩溃日志总丢" problem prior agents hit with logcat):

**Tombstones are the reliable capture** — they persist on disk through screen-lock, logcat death, and unplugging:
- Located at `/data/tombstones/tombstone_NN` (device holds ~32, slots 00–31, oldest overwritten). No root needed — they're world-readable; pull with `adb pull /data/tombstones/tombstone_NN /tmp/`.
- **The shipped `.so` retains its symbol table**, so tombstones are **self-symbolicating** (show `GameLayer::checkTower()` etc. by name — no ndk-stack needed). `fault addr 0x00000014` in `CCArray::addObject` = the CCArray receiver is NULL (its `data` field is ~offset 0x14).
- Baseline before a repro: note the newest tombstone mtime (`adb shell 'ls -lt /data/tombstones/*.pb | head'`); anything newer = fresh crash. Also `adb shell dumpsys dropbox --print` (avoid — can hang; prefer direct tombstone pull).
- Unstripped lib for manual symbolication if ever needed: `projects/NarutoSenki/proj.android/obj/local/armeabi-v7a/libcocos2dcpp.so` + `~/Library/Android/android-ndk-r10e/ndk-stack`.
- Live watch during playtest: `adb logcat -b crash` filtered for `>>> dev.leaderone.narutosenki`, `Fatal signal`, `libcocos2dcpp.so`.

**Install gotcha (avoid data-loss):** the installed v1.23 is **debug-signed** (`CN=Android Debug`, cert SHA256 `C1:9A:27:5E…`), NOT release-signed. Build & install `assembleDebug` (also `debuggable false` here, so CheckJNI stays off) — its cert matches, so `adb install -r` works with no uninstall. A **release** build uses a different key (`~/.android/keystores/narutosenki.jks`, cert `47:07:5B…`) → `INSTALL_FAILED_UPDATE_INCOMPATIBLE`. Keep device awake: `adb shell settings put global stay_on_while_plugged_in 3`.

Related: [[project-goals-and-open-bugs]], [[gbk-source-encoding]].

I have everything I need — the game is ~30 source files (22 Classes + MyUtils incl. `sqlite3.c`), 52MB Resources, and **no Mac-specific code paths** in the game (the Android JNI/anti-tamper is all `#ifdef ANDROID`, so it's excluded cleanly). Here's my plan.

## 目标
让 NarutoSenki 在这台 Apple Silicon Mac 上**编译并运行**,以 **x86_64 应用经 Rosetta 2** 运行。

## 关键决策:x86_64 + Rosetta 2(而非原生 arm64)
Mac 端第三方预编译库是 **Intel-only**(`i386/x86_64`)。原生 arm64 需要把所有依赖库全部重编,对一个 2D 游戏不划算。Rosetta 2 透明运行 x86_64,2D 游戏体验无碍。

## 实施步骤

**1. 重建丢失的 `proj.mac/NarutoSenki.xcodeproj`**
- 以可用的 `samples/Cpp/SimpleGame/proj.mac` 为模板(真实游戏工程)
- 拷贝 Mac 胶水文件(`AppController.mm`/`main.m`/`Info.plist`/`Prefix.pch`/图标/xib),`SampleGame`→`NarutoSenki`
- 脚本化写入约 30 个游戏源文件:`Classes/*.cpp`(22)+ `MyUtils/*`(含 `sqlite3.c`)
- 资源:把 `projects/NarutoSenki/Resources`(52M)挂入 Copy Resources
- 复用模板既有连接:`cocos2dx.xcodeproj` 依赖 → `libcocos2dx.a` + 系统框架(Cocoa/AppKit/OpenGL/OpenAL/AudioToolbox/QuartzCore)+ libz/libcurl

**2. 面向 Xcode 26 / Apple Silicon 的构建设置**
- `ARCHS=x86_64`、`MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET` 提到受支持值(约 10.13)
- 抑制 GBK 警告洪水:`-Wno-invalid-source-encoding`(字节保留,游戏内部按 GBK 处理)
- 本地运行关闭签名(`CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO`)

**3. 先编 cocos2dx Mac 静态库**,修 2014→2026 兼容错误(Win32 现代化的部分框架修复是共享代码,已能复用)

**4. 编游戏 target**,迭代修编译/链接错误(工作量类比 Win32 现代化)

**5. Rosetta 下运行 + 调试**:OpenGL 上下文(macOS 26 仍在但已弃用)、音频(OpenAL)、资源路径、**验证 GBK 中文渲染**(游戏用自带字体资源,GBK 字节应能对上)

## 诚实的风险
- **编译错误数量**未知,要实编才知道 — 多轮迭代
- OpenGL 在 macOS 26 已弃用(仍可用,可能有运行时小问题)
- GBK 中文渲染需实机目视确认
- 重建 pbxproj 较繁琐(我会脚本化插入文件)
- 这是**多轮迭代**任务,不是一次编过

## 产出(将提交)
- 新的 `projects/NarutoSenki/proj.mac/`(重建工程 + Mac 胶水)
- 必要的框架修复(框架多为 ASCII,常规编辑;若动到游戏 GBK 文件则字节安全)

from pbxproj import XcodeProject

# Collect NarutoSenki sources (relative to proj.mac)
patterns = ['../Classes/*.cpp', '../Classes/*.h',

for pat in patterns:

added = 0

project.save()

`CCConfiguration::gatherGPUInfo()` (CCConfiguration.cpp:111) → `std::string` を `char const*` から構築 → abort。

content.text:
`prepareOpenGL`(→`makeCurrentContext`)は AppKit が初回描画直前に遅延呼び出しします。しかし `run()`→`setOpenGLView`→`gatherGPUInfo` は `applicationDidFinishLaunching` 内で同期実行されるため、その時点でコンテキストが未カレント → `glGetString` が NULL → abort。

`run()` の直前で明示的にコンテキストをカレント化するのが根本かつ最小の修正です(proj.mac 内の AppController.mm、私の管理下・ASCII)。

火影战记が **本机(Apple Silicon Mac)上で起動・動作** するようになりました。ウィンドウ付きで今も起動したままです(タイトル「火影战记 NarutoSenki」)。

**ブランチ** — ご指示通り、macOS 作業を専用ブランチ `feat/macos-build` に分離してからコミット(`4c65f1a`)。

**Xcode 工程の新規作成** — 公式 `multi-platform-cpp` テンプレートから `proj.mac/` を再構築し、全ゲームソース + MyUtils(sqlite3 含む)を取り込み、extensions をインライン、`libcocos2dx.a` をリンク。Resources はフォルダ参照で丸ごと同梱。

**修正した 4 つの壁**(コンパイル→起動を順に突破):

| 段階 | 問題 | 対処 |
|---|---|---|
| コンパイル | 現代 AudioToolbox と衝突する AudioSession 列挙体の再定義 | `CDXMacOSXSupport.h` で該当箇所をコメントアウト |
| コンパイル | `AudioSessionGetProperty` が macOS で unavailable | `CDAudioManager.m` の 2 関数を macOS 安全実装に(元々 iOS 専用 API) |
| コンパイル | `(int)date` のポインタ→int 截断(原コードは 32bit 前提、x86_64 でエラー) | 7 箇所を `(int)(intptr_t)date` に(**バイト安全編集、GBK 完好**) |
| 起動時 abort | `gatherGPUInfo()` が GL コンテキスト未確立で `glGetString`→NULL→`std::string(NULL)` | `AppController.mm` で `run()` 前に `makeCurrentContext` を明示呼び出し |

**方式** — Mac 用サードパーティライブラリが Intel のみのため、**Rosetta 2 上で x86_64** ビルド(2D ゲームに arm64 ネイティブ化は不要と判断)。

- GPU 情報を正常採集:`Apple M4 / GL 2.1 Metal`
- 16 秒連続稼働、メニュー + BGM 段階を通過、**新規クラッシュレポートなし**
- ObjC の `AVAudioPlayer/AVAudioSession` 重複クラス警告は出るものの実害なし(音声も再生継続)

### 補足
残る警告(AVAudio* 重複クラス)は潜在リスクとして頭出ししておきます。今のところ実害はありませんが、もし特定の効果音/BGM 切り替えで問題が出たら、CocosDenshion の Mac シムを NSSound ベースに寄せる形で根治できます。

**根因**:现代 macOS 上 `NSOpenGLView` 在 Retina 屏默认用 2× 背衬(drawable=960px),但 cocos2d-x 的视口按「点」(480px)算 → 战斗只画左下 1/4。

**修法**(在我管辖的 `AppController.mm` 里,不碰框架深层):

2. **窗口内容尺寸直接设为 960×640(2×)** → `setFrameSize(960,640)` 使 `m_fScaleX=2`,视口 = 480×2 = 960px 填满,同时窗口物理变大(满足③)。

input.content:
#!/bin/bash
# ============================================================
#  火影战记 NarutoSenki — macOS 启动脚本(双击即可运行)
#  对应 win32 版的「启动游戏.bat」。
#
#  资源已打包进 .app(通过 Contents/Resources),无需手动
#  设置工作目录。App 为 x86_64,在 Apple Silicon 上经 Rosetta 2
#  自动运行。
#
#  首次运行若尚未编译,脚本会自动用 xcodebuild 编译一次(较慢),
#  之后直接启动已编译产物。
# ============================================================

# 切到脚本所在目录(projects/NarutoSenki)
cd "$(dirname "$0")" || exit 1

PROJ="proj.mac/NarutoSenki.xcodeproj"

find_app() {
    find "$HOME/Library/Developer/Xcode/DerivedData"/NarutoSenki-*/Build/Products/Debug \
        -maxdepth 1 -name "NarutoSenki.app" 2>/dev/null | head -1
}

APP="$(find_app)"

if [ -z "$APP" ] || [ ! -d "$APP" ]; then
    echo "未找到已编译的 App,正在编译(x86_64,首次较慢)……"
    xcodebuild -project "$PROJ" -scheme NarutoSenki -configuration Debug \
        CODE_SIGNING_ALLOWED=NO build || {
        echo
        echo "[错误] 编译失败。请先在 Xcode 中打开 $PROJ 手动编译,或检查上方日志。"
        echo "按任意键关闭……"
        read -r -n1
        exit 1
    }
    APP="$(find_app)"
fi

if [ -z "$APP" ] || [ ! -d "$APP" ]; then
    echo "[错误] 编译后仍未找到 NarutoSenki.app。"
    read -r -n1
    exit 1
fi

echo "启动:$APP"
open "$APP"

承接 macOS 版首跑,修复实机反馈的一批问题:

崩溃 / 逻辑
- MD5 在 64 位下崩溃:CMD5Checksum.h 的 DWORD/ULONG 由 unsigned long
  (LP64 下 8 字节)改为 unsigned int(全平台 32 位)。原 RotateLeft 的
  ASSERT(sizeof==4) 直接触发 abort,导致「选角色→开始游戏」必崩;
  且 32 位回绕是 MD5 正确性前提。该 MD5 的防篡改比对分支早已被注释、无副作用。
- Exit 无效:StartMenu::onExitCallBack 增加 CC_PLATFORM_MAC 分支 exit(0)
  (原仅处理 Android/Win32)。
- CREDITS 等界面无法返回:EAGLView keyDown 把 Esc(keyCode 53)派发为
  kTypeBackClicked,接通 keyBackClicked(对齐 win32 的 ESC→back)。

渲染 / 窗口
- 紫色糊字体:mac CCImage.mm 文字渲染弃用 [image lockFocus]+
  initWithFocusedViewRect(Retina 下抓到 2x、格式不定的位图,却按
  POTWide*POTHigh*4 拷贝 → RGB 垃圾)。改为自建、先清零的 RGBA8888
  NSBitmapImageRep,格式与 GL 上传严格一致。
- 画面缩到窗口左下角:AppController 关闭 Retina 最佳分辨率背衬
  (setWantsBestResolutionOpenGLSurface:NO),令 drawable 像素=窗口点数,
  setViewPortInPoints 按点算即可填满(菜单/战斗一致)。
- 窗口放大:内容尺寸设为 480x320 的 kWinScale 倍(默认 2 → 960x640,
  与 win32 的 setFrameZoomFactor(2) 手感一致;调常量即可更大)。

Xcode 可编译(GUI Cmd+R)
- Ld 失败真因:MACOSX_DEPLOYMENT_TARGET=10.6 → 新 Xcode 缺 libarclite。
  NarutoSenki 与 cocos2dx 两个 proj.mac 部署目标提到 10.13。
- 第三方 mac 库仅 i386/x86_64(无 arm64),两工程锁 ARCHS=x86_64 +
  ONLY_ACTIVE_ARCH=NO,Apple Silicon 上经 Rosetta 运行。

资源 / 工具
- 图标:用安卓工程 res/drawable-hdpi/icon.png 生成标准 .icns,替换
  cocos 默认图标。
- 新增 projects/NarutoSenki/启动游戏.command:双击启动(缺产物则自动
